strategies.note: Primary. An extension file in ~/.pi/agent/extensions (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR honoured) reads named fields of the events it subscribes to; prompts, tool inputs and outputs are never touched, and pi's settings are not edited.

No native scheduler source exposed by the pi coding agent. Reports unsupported/no_native_scheduler. Extensions and the separate Durable SDK require their own identified contract; no files or credentials read.
